_about: Exact DEV-RECENT image payloads per (question_id, N) for StudyDevOne / StudyDeviceLatency / StudyDevFast. Frames are 560x560 PNGs (PIL/ffmpeg lanczos), each preceded by its [t=Xs] marker, then question_text(rec). N=37/18/9 = StudyDevFast selection; N=1 = frame at/nearest-before qt. sha256 is of the raw PNG bytes sent (base64) to llama.cpp. PNG bytes live in Orin scratch (devrecent_frames); use these hashes to verify identical inputs.
